title: BonkDAO, which oversees the Bonk memecoin, says it was the target of a "malicious governance proposal" that resulted in a loss of $20M worth of Bonk tokens (Daniel Kuhn/The Block)
summary: Daniel Kuhn / The Block: BonkDAO, which oversees the Bonk memecoin, says it was the target of a “malicious governance proposal” that resulted in a loss of $20M worth of Bonk tokens — Quick Take — BonkDAO was hit with a governance attack that appears to have drained approximately $20 million worth of BONK tokens …
contentText:
Daniel Kuhn / The Block :

BonkDAO, which oversees the Bonk memecoin, says it was the target of a “malicious governance proposal” that resulted in a loss of $20M worth of Bonk tokens   —  Quick Take  — BonkDAO was hit with a governance attack that appears to have drained approximately $20 million worth of BONK tokens …
